metadata.description: Superseded historical Candidate TP4 recipe for the unpruned GLM 5.2 Int4/Int8 checkpoint. It is unsupported on Vonk's current one- or two-Spark configuration: a two-rank split alone would require at least 202.8 GB of checkpoint bytes per Spark before KV cache or runtime overhead, above the roughly 126.9 GB-per-node inventory. The immutable contract remains installable for reproducibility; its archived upstream directs four-node users to DFlash, while glm-5-3-flash-exl3-dflash2-vllm-dual is the current 126 GB-admission-envelope GLM alternative.
metadata.title: GLM 5.2 QuantTrio four Sparks (superseded)
